accomplishments.description: Fixed Hermes Gateway launchd service on M4 (Rae) - was failing with ghost PID lock errors
accomplishments.details: Root cause: gateway/status.py used Linux-only /proc filesystem calls that silently return None on macOS, breaking stale lock detection. Opus fixed with macOS-specific ps commands.

accomplishments.description: Verified Janet gateway - already running correctly with --replace in plist
accomplishments.details: All 3 platforms connected: Discord (hermes-janet#9359), Telegram (polling), WhatsApp (bridge)

tech_notes: Fix required: ps -p {pid} -o lstart=, ps -p {pid} -o command=, ps -p {pid} -o state=
Both machines now running via launchd with --replace flag
